scope: loopback-only server; private synthetic repositories; disposable SQLite state under /tmp
evidence: Initial protocol-v1 trial PR response with draft=false despite request field draft=true
GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls?state=all&head=researcher%3Afeature&base=main returned zero; head=feature&base=main returned one
Repeated POST of the same synthetic PR returned HTTP 409 and did not create a second PR
Protocol-v1 candidate_reconciliation remote_drift row recorded stale lease rejection and branch SHA equal to the competing SHA
Protocol-v1 exact-SHA status observer returned the selected context for candidate and no matching context for base
limitations: These are observations for this Forgejo release and configuration only.
The initial protocol-v1 matrix used a faulty head filter and assumed API draft support; its PR recovery outcomes are retained separately and are not used as protocol-v2 outcome evidence.
The retained protocol-v2 matrix uses ordinary open PRs and never merges them; this does not establish Draft PR behavior required by the Altruforge MVP.
